description: This class defines an actor named SingletonStatusReporter that reports the health status of a singleton actor within an Akka cluster, ensuring reporting only if the node is the cluster role leader.

classes.name: SingletonStatusReporter
classes.description: An actor class for reporting health status specifically in a clustered environment, based on leadership status.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Props for actor instantiation, encapsulating cluster role and singleton proxy dependencies.

methods.name: matchCustomMessages
methods.description: Handles incoming messages of type RetrieveHealthResponse and updates health status accordingly.

methods.name: triggerHealthRetrieval
methods.description: Initiates health data retrieval if the node is the cluster role leader; otherwise, reports 'not my business'.

methods.name: isThisClusterRoleLeader
methods.description: Determines whether the current node is the leader for the specified cluster role.
